Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager
AUTOSAR CP R20-11
7.9.6.2 Continuous-MI counter
The counter
Continuous-MI counter
is representing the number of engine hours
during which the MIL was continuously commanded to be on.
[SWS_Dem_01141]
⌈
If Activation Mode 4 becomes active the counter shall be reset
to 0.
⌋
()
[SWS_Dem_01142]
⌈
The counter shall increment for each engine operating hour dur-
ing which the event is detected and the Continuous-MI is commanded to be on.
⌋
()
[SWS_Dem_01143]
⌈
The counter shall halt its value when the Continuous-MI is no
longer commanded to be on.
⌋
()
[SWS_Dem_01144]
⌈
The counter shall continue its incrementation if the Continuous-
MI is again commanded on within three operation sequences.
⌋
()
[SWS_Dem_01145]
⌈
The counter shall reset to zero and start incrementing its value
if the Continuous-MI is again commanded on after more than three operation se-
quences.
⌋
()
[SWS_Dem_01146]
⌈
The counter shall reset to zero if the Continuous-MI is not com-
manded on after more than 40 warm-up cycles or after more than 200 engine operating
hours or upon a ClearDTC request.
⌋
()
[SWS_Dem_01147]
⌈
The counter shall be reported as a two byte value. If any count
operation occurs which would cause a counter to roll over past 0x00FF then the count
value shall instead be maintained at 0x00FF.
⌋
()
[SWS_Dem_01148]
⌈
The counter shall be stored non-volatile.
⌋
()

The counter
Cumulative Continuous-MI counter
is representing the number of
engine hours during which MIL has been continuously commanded to be on during its
lifetime. The counter shall only be implemented in the
VOBD
